title: agents-inc: Cross-Vendor Governance for an Agentic-AI Workforce
description:
agents-inc: Run your AI subscriptions like a small company you direct: a Lead splits each request among Workers, a script checks every result, and a reviewer must accept it. It is a Python package that hands work from one AI coding session to other models and checks the result before anyone accepts it. It supports Claude, Codex, Gemini, Mistral and OpenRouter capacity, so you can delegate as you please across subscriptions. A four-rung ladder (Executive, Orchestrator, Workhorse, Grunt) sets the model management. A model never grades its own work: on the governed path, each result passes deterministic checks, then a reviewer, and the decision goes into an append-only ledger. The main entry point is the agents-inc command (dispatch, doctor, repair, ledger). Install with pip install agents-inc, then run agents-inc install; the import name is agents_inc. The project is experimental, and no measurements of efficacy have been benchmarked yet.

This release (0.7.0)

0.7.0 adds a host CLI currency check, changes dispatch verdicts and moves the default Codex pins.

Added

  • agents-inc doctor and repair report an outdated Codex or Claude Code CLI and a model pin the installed CLI cannot run. The check looks up the latest version at the npm registry and sends nothing that identifies you; AGENTS_INC_NO_UPDATE_CHECK turns it off.

Changed

  • A write dispatch that changes nothing in scope while its gates pass now ends unverified with reason no-changes and exits 4. Scripts that read exit codes must handle it.
  • agents-inc models exits 1 and prints NOT-IN-CATALOG for a pin the CLI catalog does not list.
  • Every dispatch prompt carries a rewritten stop-on-block clause.
  • The default pins astra and sol move to gpt-6.2-astra and gpt-6.2-sol.
  • Host-native delegation is the preferred route.
  • Status line SESS cells take a pace colour after 5 minutes.

Fixed

  • DelegateAgent reports a timeout as a timeout and a rejected model as such, not as a login failure.
  • Dispatch from inside a Codex or Claude Code sandbox reports blocked instead of snapshot-error (#207).
  • The secret screen no longer refuses a quoted error after "the run failed" (#155).

Roadmap at 0.7.0

  • Now: measure the token cost of delegation against doing the work in one session, and port the test suite to Windows (#138).
  • Next: let a Worker launched by a broker lead its own Workers (#73).
  • Later: route work by data classification (#19).
